text: 3 Chairs is a musical supergroup consisting of Detroit house music producers Kenny "Moodymann" Dixon Jr., Theo Parrish, Rick Wilhite, and Marcellus Pittman. The group began as a trio in 1997 before the addition of Pittman in 2003.
In 2021, the group released the 35-track retrospective compilation 3 Chairs Collection (1997-2013) for digital download.
